stem: A controller reports a fault code outside Technician I training. What is the correct boundary?
choices: Guess a repair based on the code wording
Ignore the code if plants look normal
Record the code/context and escalate according to the supplied procedure rather than attempting unauthorized repair
rationale: Record the code/context and escalate according to the supplied procedure rather than attempting unauthorized repair. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
